On the current merged pin, use fresh-head trivial and known-defect canary PRs. Record verdict and gate run URLs, exact target heads, workflow/pin SHA and App-authenticated posted statuses. Any pin promotion made while completing this item repeats the post-merge canary check. A failure remains a blocker or follows the documented rollback, without bypass.
